metadata.title: Independent recognition regression corpus
metadata.prices: All prices are fictional teaching values in RUB, never a working supplier price list.
metadata.oracle: Handwritten cases and fixed generated-group SKU expectations were authored independently of the parser/matcher. Generated queries are deterministic Cartesian products of explicit string parts; they do not infer expectations from product names.
metadata.real_supplier_fixtures: Real user-supplied fragments remain separately in examples/request_price_excerpt.txt and examples/supplier_price_excerpt.txt; this file is synthetic.
metadata.scope: Conservative model/brand/version/spec matching; listed aliases only. An ambiguous or unsupported request must not fall back to a neighboring model.
metadata.expansion: Each generated group enumerates parts in JSON order with itertools.product; duplicate query strings inside one group are removed without changing order.
metadata.context: A case may restrict the catalogue with catalog_skus; by default all competing products are present. Expected SKUs must be within that explicit context.
